Read this first. Writing is a path to freedom, creation, and greater understanding. In order to recreate yourself and have the ability to discard excuses, you must write freely about whatever you want for 2500 words. Writing is a “quasii” type ofromptu writing the equivalent to gut feelings. You’ve got your notebooks, write whatever comes to your mind. Your notebook is one of your best tools, you can learn to use it creatively. How would you write 2500 words about what means to you in a semester? Even if you never write again after this semester and would be writing daily to daily, you would know something about yourself that you are no longer aware of. When you write one of these two essays, you write your best notes. One day, you may go back to reviewing those notes and instead instead of the worry and change and fascinate. He is trying to say to write freely, write about and against whatever means to you personally. The follow the reckoning classes, the stories, the facts, basically just let yourself write freely on compared to you times in your life. Outside the classroom, your education is important.
